svg.text: D flip-flop with asynchronous preset (SN = 0) · DFF_J2N16 + one 6Kh7B double diode
Master M: S = D, R = ~D, E = C. Slave S: S = QM, R = QNM, E = ~C. Л901a inverts D, Л901b inverts C; each inverter plate reaches its latch through a divider (470k ‖ C / 200k).
Master outputs reach the slave through their own 2.7 pF dividers; the slave enable divider has 13.6 pF (the clock edge is delayed against D).
SN is the reset line (idle −20 V, GND = set): one diode of Л902 to FQ of each latch pulls the triode on plate QN on, so Q goes high. Cc 2.7 pF (Q → FQ) compensates the diode capacitance.
The RS latches are drawn as blocks: their circuit is on the RSLATCH_J2N16 page.
Heater 6.3 V on H1/H2 of every tube, all in parallel, not drawn.
